leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Email addresses, or objects such as {"email": "jane@acme.de", "countryCode": "DE", "source": "apollo"}. Ignored when a dataset ID or CSV URL is given.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: Check the output of another Actor run, for example a lead scraper. Nested fields such as location.country are found automatically.

csvUrl.title: CSV URL
csvUrl.description: A public link to a CSV export. The first row must be the header.

emailField.title: Email field
emailField.description: Leave empty to detect it. Example: workEmail.

countryField.title: Country field
countryField.description: Where the person is, not where the company is headquartered. Leave empty to detect it. Example: location.country.

sourceField.title: Address source field
sourceField.description: Optional. Values like published or company website vs. vendor, apollo or hunter. In Canada, Australia, the Netherlands, Slovakia and Slovenia the verdict depends on it.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Two-letter code used when the country is unknown and the domain does not tell it, for example US.

keepOriginalFields.title: Keep the original fields
keepOriginalFields.description: Output every input field plus the verdict fields (prefixed law_).
